title: Exterior Facade & Chimney Ideas | May 2026 GenStone Projects
description: Explore May 2026 GenStone exterior facade and chimney projects. See real homeowner curb appeal transformations and get inspired for your next exterior upgrade.
text: GenStone Project Highlights – May 2026 Exterior Facade & Chimney Update Projects Amanda Lombard Director May is one of the busiest months for exterior home improvements, and homeowners across the country are taking advantage of warmer weather to tackle curb appeal projects. This month's featured installs focus on exterior facades and foundation upgrades that dramatically improve the appearance of a home while creating a more finished and cohesive look. The outside looks great and really improved the overall appearance of our home.” FAQs Ask Away. We've Heard it All. Are GenStone panels weather resistant? Yes. GenStone panels are designed to withstand outdoor conditions including rain, snow, and temperature changes, making them suitable for exterior projects. Amanda Lombard Director Can GenStone be installed indoors and outdoors? Yes. GenStone panels are designed for both interior and exterior applications. They are commonly used for accent walls, fireplace surrounds, entryways, garages, outdoor kitchens, and exterior facades. Evan Trevenna Senior Project Coordinator How do I estimate how much GenStone I need for my project? You can use the GenStone material calculator or contact a Project Coordinator for a full estimate. Most homeowners measure the square footage of the wall area and then account for corners, trim, and a small 5% waste factor. Travis Choate Project Coordinator Do GenStone panels require maintenance? GenStone requires very little maintenance. Most installations only need occasional cleaning with mild soap and water to remove dust or debris.
